notes: Their main damage was Eden (14k physical); 1/5 of us itemized armor — that hurt.
Enemy ran 0/5 on or near their meta core — they were off-meta too, the win was there.

draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: Nine won fights, nine cashed — a perfect conversion game, 25-7, every major on our side of the ledger.
coaching.team: This is what the film program wants every week: 9-for-9 turning fights into Fangtooth (7, 13, 18), Genesis (22), Orb and Primal (25), while they cashed zero. The paper reads said carry and jungle were behind; the scoreboard (Murdock 11/0, Kallari 12/2) overruled the paper — worth saying both. The sloppiness a better team punishes: three deaths caught alone outside any fight (Renna 2.6, Shinbi 9 and 18 — the 18-minute one preceded a tower), and no anti-heal into Narbash per the kit read; a stronger enemy makes those long fights cost.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 13-minute 5-0 wipe at our Fangtooth — five of them into three of us and they lost every body — then every subsequent fight cashed on schedule.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock, 11/0/12 with 28.4k objective damage into a lane that read theirs on paper — the film's answer to the read. Nothing to fix on the line itself; the deathless carry is why 9-for-9 was possible.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Phase went 2/0/23 with 18.1k healing and 15 wards — every fight had the lifeline attached. The build note stands for next time: Galaxy Greaves was the missing core piece, and anti-heal into a Narbash comp is the support slot's buy.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari 12/2 with 23.9k objective damage — the fights were won at the arrival angles Kallari created, and the objective damage cashed them. The one habit: 1 ward against the 5 norm. On a 27-minute stomp it never mattered; against an even team it does.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi's 4 deaths against a 2 norm were the only red line on our board — two of them caught alone (9 and 18 minutes, the second preceding a tower). The lane flipped from theirs early to ours late, so the trade was fine; the solo deaths are the cut.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna went 5/2/8 on a near-first-time hero with an on-core build (Entropy, Wraith Leggings) — the 2.6-minute catch by Khaimera was the only early wobble, and the Magnify spike at 24 lined up with the fight streak that closed it.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura
